sector: Coal mining (thermal coal; Coal India subsidiary, Odisha)
brlm: SBI Capital Markets, Axis Capital, BOB Capital Markets, IDBI Capital Markets & Securities, IIFL Capital Services

company_pe.pat_basis: attributable to owners; total Rs 10,698.12 cr
company_pe.source: RHP pp. 121-123 (Basis for Offer Price); PAT p. 88
company_pe.note: EPS is on 661.84 crore shares after the Aug-2026 split of Rs 1,000 shares into Rs 2 shares; the offer is a pure OFS, so the share count does not change. FY26 PAT includes about Rs 1,859 cr (pre-tax) of income the company itself calls non-recurring; on recurring profit the P/E at Rs 136 is about 9.7x. Price band confirmed by the company on 16-Nov-2026.

business_stage: Mature, cash-generative (India's largest single coal producer; pays out about 80% of profit)

anchor.source: Anchor bidding 18-Nov-2026; allocation not yet published at writing

model.reverse_dcf: The price asks the business to deliver 12.2 times its current free cash flow, in perpetuity.

call_basis: Call rule (ROUTINE.md hard rule 6), judged at the upper band of Rs 136 (confirmed by the company's price-band announcement on 16-Nov-2026): Neutral value Rs 141 is 3.4% above the price, better than the -10% limit, so the call is Subscribe. On recurring FY26 earnings (excluding Rs 1,859 cr of one-off income) the Neutral value is about Rs 130 (-4%), still within the Subscribe limb. The call holds up to about Rs 156. No material governance or accounting issue; the lack of independent directors is a known PSU pattern with an exemption sought from SEBI.
reference_note: Band Rs 129-136, lot 110 (company announcement, 16-Nov-2026; RHP prints [●]). Pure OFS by Coal India: 661.84 crore shares before and after; market cap Rs 90,010 cr at Rs 136. P/E 8.4x FY26 PAT to owners (9.7x on recurring profit); company's own P/E 8.43x basic = diluted (8.00x at Rs 129); P/B 4.2x; EV/EBITDA 5.8x after Rs 16,085 cr net cash; trailing dividend yield 9.3% (FY26 dividends Rs 8,400 cr).
headline: India's largest single coal producer (21% of national output, about 45 years of reserves, FY26 revenue Rs 30,550 cr, operating EBITDA margin 42%, no debt) sold entirely by Coal India at 8.4x FY26 earnings (9.7x recurring) with a 9.3% trailing dividend yield; fair value Rs 141 (Subscribe) as a yield-and-value holding, while revenue has eased for two years and margins have slipped to 40%.
red_flags: FY26 PAT includes Rs 1,859 cr pre-tax of income the company calls non-recurring: tax-refund interest Rs 1,163.92 cr and write-backs Rs 695.38 cr (pp. 512-513)
Pure OFS: the company receives nothing; Coal India keeps 90% and must sell more to meet minimum public shareholding (pp. 80, 570)
No independent directors at the RHP date; SEBI exemption sought (p. 42). Contingent liabilities 56% of net worth, mostly income tax (p. 24)
Band Rs 129-136 (confirmed); fair value Rs 127 / 141 / 151 vs Rs 136

strengths: India's largest single coal producer, 21% of output (p. 230)
No debt; net cash about Rs 16,085 cr (pp. 86-87)
weaknesses: Revenue and profit down two years running (p. 88)
opportunities: Coal demand about +4% a year to FY31 (p. 167)
